name: Annealed copper conductor of electric wire (International Annealed Copper Standard)
name_ja: 電線の軟銅導体 (万国標準軟銅)
standard: International Annealed Copper Standard (IACS, 100 % conductivity), as stated in NBS Handbook 100
condition: annealed copper of 100 % IACS conductivity at 20 degC; the standard's defined reference values, not minima of a wire standard (JIS C 3102 not read); mechanical and thermal-conduction properties not found in a source read

resistivity_ohm_m.source: National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100 'Copper Wire Tables' (1966), section 1.1 and Appendix 5: volume resistivity of the International Annealed Copper Standard 0.017241 ohm mm2/m (1.7241 microhm cm) at 20 degC, a defined reference value; 1.7241e-08 ohm m is the unit conversion

density_kg_m3.source: National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100 'Copper Wire Tables' (1966), section 1.1 and Appendix 5: density of the International Annealed Copper Standard taken as 8.89 g/cm3 at 20 degC (a defined value)

thermal_expansion_per_K.source: National Bureau of Standards Handbook 100 'Copper Wire Tables' (1966), section 1.1 and Appendix 5: coefficient of linear expansion 0.000017 per degC (at 20 degC) of the International Annealed Copper Standard
